name: footer_empty
reason: Bar bg-color requires Ink to emit colored whitespace. Ink trims trailing-whitespace Text elements and does not accept backgroundColor on Box, so a 1-row bar of pure spaces produces no ANSI output. Suppress until either Box backgroundColor is supported or the bar is filled with a non-whitespace anchor (e.g. show_command_palette adds chars on the right).

name: footer_with_bindings
reason: Binding-chip race fixed in .11.1 (chips now render via MobX-tracked observer reads). Pixel parity still blocked on (a) dock-bottom layout — JS Footer renders at the top of the FixtureScreen flex column instead of bottom, and (b) bar background fill — Ink's whitespace-only colored Text emits no ANSI, so the FOOTER_BACKGROUND fill segment is invisible. Tracked under .11.2 and follow-up framework gaps.
